theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_hi_linepow_coefficients
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), MvPolynomial.coeff d (HeckeEis.linePow n z).val = if d 0 + d 1 = n then (Nat.choose n (d 0) : ℂ) * z ^ (d 0) else 0
